biotools.summary: CTAT-LR-Fusion detects fusion transcripts from long-read RNA-seq data (PacBio Iso-seq or Oxford Nanopore) and can leverage Illumina RNA-seq data for additional exploration and quantification. It is a component of the Trinity Cancer Transcriptome Analysis Toolkit and is available via GitHub and Docker.
